name: ChatGPT

surfaces.name: ChatGPT Skills (Business, Enterprise, Healthcare and Edu workspaces)
steps: Download design-dna-chatgpt-skill.zip from the latest release, or build it: python install.py package --target chatgpt
In ChatGPT, open Plugins in the sidebar, then the Skills tab.
Select Create, then Upload from your computer, and choose the zip. It holds one top-level folder, reverse-design/.
Enterprise and Edu only: a workspace admin enables Skills first, under Permissions & Roles in the admin dashboard.
Start a chat, attach a reference image and ask: Scan this design with Design DNA and save it as "Spring Launch".
surfaces.limits: Not offered on Free, Plus or Pro; use the instruction kit there.

surfaces.name: Projects or custom GPTs (Free, Plus, Pro, or any workspace without Skills)
steps: Project: paste INSTRUCTIONS.md into the project instructions and add the files in knowledge/ as project files.
Custom GPT: paste INSTRUCTIONS.md into Instructions (it stays under 8,000 characters) and upload the files in knowledge/ as Knowledge.
The assistant must label every answer as instruction-only: nothing is measured, rendered or verified.
surfaces.limits: A fallback, not a skill. Running the engine's Python by hand in ChatGPT's data analysis tool is possible in principle but not supported or tested.

not_available: The public plugin directory shared by ChatGPT and Codex lists plugins after OpenAI publishes them; Design DNA is not listed there.
prerequisites: Native: a ChatGPT Business, Enterprise, Healthcare or Edu workspace with Skills enabled
Fallback: any ChatGPT plan with Projects or custom GPTs

docs.title: Skills in ChatGPT
docs.facts: Business, Enterprise, Healthcare and Edu plans; Free, Plus and Pro are not in the rollout. Plugins in the sidebar, Skills tab. Create, then Upload from your computer. Enterprise and Edu admins enable Skills under Permissions & Roles. skill-creator is included by default.

docs.title: Build skills
docs.facts: A skill is a folder anchored by SKILL.md with name and description. ChatGPT and Codex read the name and description first and load SKILL.md when they use the skill.

docs.title: Skills (API guide)
docs.facts: Upload a zip that contains a single top-level folder (recommended). The API accepts zips up to 50 MB and up to 500 files per hosted skill version.

docs.title: Package your plugin
docs.facts: Public plugins are published once to the universal plugin directory shared by ChatGPT and Codex; local and repository marketplaces serve authoring, testing and team distribution.
